title Escarcha - the frozen sea islands and ice caves: glassy pings in E major that ring and echo off the ice (a faint copy a beat later), slow major-seventh shimmers underneath, a wind that sweeps through, then a fast glitter of sixteenths (80 bpm, crystalline)
tempo 80
vol 215
meter 4/4
inst pe arp=-12,-8,-5,-1 rate=8 att=6 lvl=0.45 slow
inst pc arp=-12,-9,-5,-2 rate=8 att=6 lvl=0.45 slow
inst ice dec=3 sus=0.02 slow
inst ice2 dec=3 sus=0.02 lvl=0.35 slow
inst wind drum=g7 v=20,55,100,150,190,150,100,55,20 noise=70 seed=4 slow
l8
# --- 1-8: ping and echo over E, C sharp minor, A, B; the wind bends the last bar
@pe o4 e2 e2 |
@ice o6 e8 @ice2 e8 @ice o6 g+8 @ice2 g+8 @ice o6 b8 @ice2 b8 @ice o7 e4 |
@pc o4 c+2 c+2 |
@ice o6 c+8 @ice2 c+8 @ice o6 e8 @ice2 e8 @ice o6 g+8 @ice2 g+8 @ice o6 b4 |
@pe o4 a2 a2 |
@ice o6 a8 @ice2 a8 @ice o6 e8 @ice2 e8 @ice o6 c+8 @ice2 c+8 @ice o6 e4 |
@pe o4 b2 b2 |
@ice o6 f+8 @ice2 f+8 @ice o6 a+8 @ice2 a+8 @ice o7 d+4 !wind4 |
# --- 9-12: the glitter (sixteenths over E, C sharp minor, A, B), then one long ping
@ice o6 [ e16 g+16 b16 >e16< ]4 |
@ice o6 [ c+16 e16 g+16 >c+16< ]4 |
@ice o6 [ e16 a16 >c+16 e16< ]4 |
@ice o6 [ f+16 a+16 >d+16 f+16< ]4 |
